name: mast
description: Lay down the MAST source tree for the 'unit' role via tools/mast-clone.ps1 (one venv at <Top>\.venv, repos at <Top>\{common,unit,claude,supervision}), and open the unit API firewall port. Registers no Windows service itself: the supervisor's mast-service is installed by the mast-service module on supervised units only, and the four legacy services stay removed (#159).
